name: Horus
subtitle: Eye of Aaru
description: Taunt your foes whilst mitigating critical damage alongside Isis.
lore: The Avenger, son of Ra and Isis, has become Aaru’s war leader since the Shattering. He leads his people and fellow gods against Omeyocan’s armies in the War of Pyramids, while still standing firm against Apophis and other forces of Chaos. These multi-front conflicts take their toll, and Horus worries that one might attain victory while he deals with the other.
divinity_generator: Gain [40] Divinity when hit by an enemy. Gain an additional [40] Divinity when the enemy is under [Taunt].

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Shield Multiplier +30%, DMG Multiplier +30%, Turn Meter Multiplier +20%
Attunement Multiplier +50%, Armor Multiplier +30%, Weapon Multiplier +30%

skills.name: Omniscient Eye
skills.description:
Place [mechanic:shield]300% DEF on all allies. If Isis is on the team, this [mechanic:shield] cannot be removed and is 30% stronger.
Then has a 80% chance to place [mechanic:taunt] for 2 turns on all enemies.
skills.awakening_bonus: At the start of the wave, Place [Taunt] on all enemies for 1 Turn.

skills.name: Falcon Strike
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (370%DEF+125%ATK) with a 75% chance to place [mechanic:spd-down-ii] and [mechanic:blunt-ii] on all enemies for 2 turns.

skills.name: Falcon Surge
skills.description: When this hero is attacked by enemies under [mechanic:taunt], Increase the turn meter of all allies by 5%.
skills.awakening_bonus: Also increases the damage of this hero’s next Ultimate by 3%.

skills.name: Havoc Force
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (210%DEF+130%ATK) with a 50% chance to place [mechanic:taunt] on the target for 1 turn. Also Heal 70%DEF this hero. If Isis is on the team, she is healed by the same amount.
skills.awakening_bonus: Retaliates with the Basic Ability when an enemy attacks this hero.

imprint_passive: When this hero is attacked by enemies under [Taunt], Increase the turn meter of all allies by 2.5%.
